correctness.rationale: Independent recursive-tree parent choices remain uniform after conditioning later parents to avoid a fixed birth label; deleting that leaf gives a probability-preserving bijection to a smaller uniform tree and independent insertion parent. The exact harmonic expectation yields the covariance. Strictly increasing adjacent differences and the unique greatest two-adic denominator in a reciprocal interval exclude a tie. Integral harmonic estimates prove the 1/e limiting index and -1/e limiting value. Exhaustive rational checks through n=9 and optimal-age checks through n=300 independently corroborate arithmetic, without substituting for the proof.

originality.rationale: The claim is the birth-indexed conditional distribution and exact unique age extremum, NOT the unmarked total covariance. Inspected primary work covers large-degree depth limits (Eslava), generic path-length functionals (Grübel-Michailow) and unmarked joint path/external-path/leaf-count generating functions (Lundblad-Wagner). The latter gives stronger coverage of the aggregate corollary and is explicitly acknowledged. Related published findings cover root-attachment effects, not the event that a specific age-labelled vertex has no children. No equivalent marked law or age-extremizer was found in actual full-text and semantic searches; unlocated folklore remains a stated risk.
residual_risks: The conditional delete-and-reinsert bijection is elementary enough that an unindexed folklore statement or textbook lemma may exist.

value.rationale: The age label is intrinsic to chronological recursive trees. Forcing a specific vertex to finish as a leaf is a natural conditioned-growth event with nonlocal effects on global path length. The exact law exhibits a nonmonotone marked dependence profile and a unique finite-order strongest-negative covariance age, whose asymptotic fraction is 1/e; this distinguishes the age-aware problem from the classical unmarked aggregate and provides an exact natural extremal classification. No unproved downstream consequences are invoked.
